title: Quasi-regular immersions of spaces characterized by finite presentation, finite locally free conormal, and the conormal-algebra isomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For an immersion i : Z -> X of spaces over S, the lemma gives the three-condition dictionary: i is quasi-regular iff i is locally of finite presentation, the conormal sheaf C_{Z/X} is finite locally free, and the canonical map from the symmetric algebra of the conormal sheaf to the conormal algebra (the chapter's displayed equation conormal-algebra-quotient) is an isomorphism — the practical test used throughout the regularity-flavour web. The retained proof is written: via the etale-local Definition definition-regular-immersion and the conormal-algebra etale-compatibility lemma (chapter lemma etale-conormal-algebra), the assertion is etale-local on X, reducing verbatim to the schemes theorem Divisors, lemma quasi-regular-immersion. Retained author proof at lines 10616-10622.
